ModMetaData.description:
Updated from TheElm's mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2870663873
And an unknown member who made it for 1.5, but they deleted it now.
I'm also bad at coding, and the original code used Transpilers which actually search for/inject code. I just patched Rimworld's function that checks for roof: Nothing checks for a roof besides these specific buildings, so I just patched that instead!
Lets you use the scanners indoors
Should include: -Long Range Mineral Scanner -Ground Penetrating Scanner -Orbital Scanner (from Odyssey DLC)
Because scanning is just that important
